name: shell_commands
title: Shell History
description: Command history: what was typed and what came back.

fields.name: session_id
fields.help: Groups the turns of one conversation. Minted by the page at load; the server stamps it on every turn so a session can be listed and resumed.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.help: Wall time of the provider round(s), for the 'why was that slow' question.

fields.name: tool_calls
fields.help: JSON list of tool names the model called this turn.
